subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Doze
solution:
The correct answer is: **Wake**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Doze **means to sleep lightly or to nap. (झपकी लेना)

 
 
• **For example- ***I think I'll have a doze, he said, closing his eyes.*
 
 
 
• The opposite of sleeping is waking up, which is the meaning of "**Wake**." (जगाना)
 
 
• **For example-* ****What time did you wake up this morning?*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us look at the meaning of the other words.

 
• **Cold **means having a low temperature or lacking warmth. (ठंडा)
 
• **Neglect **means failing to care for others properly or to ignore them. (उपेक्षा करना)
 
• **Snooze **means to sleep lightly or to doze off. (दिन में झपकी लेना)
